name: Yao Guang
description:
Mysterious, bold, radical... her quest for change is stunning.
With the "eye" of The Hunt, she sees all fates. Though she knows fate is immutable, the Seer Strategist still walks into danger alone.
With the odds stacked against her, how can she possibly change her destiny?

skills.name: Whistlebolt Sings Joy
skills.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Yao Guang's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to #2[i]% of Yao Guang's ATK to targets adjacent to it. The Energy regenerated from Basic ATK increases to 30.
skills.simpleDesc: Deals minor Physical DMG to one enemy target and minor Physical DMG to adjacent targets.

skills.name: Decalight Unveils All
skills.desc: Deploys a Zone for #1[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While the Zone is active, increases all allies' Elation by an amount equal to #2[f1]% of Yao Guang's Elation. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains #3[i] Punchline.
skills.simpleDesc: Deploys a Zone that increases Elation for all ally targets. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains Punchline.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

skills.name: Hexagram of Feathered Fortune
skills.desc: Gains #1[i] Punchline. Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of #4[i] Punchline is taken into account. This turn, does not consume Punchline, and increases all allies' All-Type RES PEN by #2[f1]% for #3[i] turn(s).
skills.simpleDesc: Gains Punchline. Immediately grants Aha 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of Punchline is taken into account, and increases all allies' All-Type RES PEN.

extra.name: Punchline
extra.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

extra.name: Aha
extra.desc:
When taking action, triggers an Aha Instant and causes units capable of using Elation Skills to each use their Elation Skill 1 time. If there are no units capable of using Elation Skills when Aha takes action, Aha will use "Let There Be Laughter."
The Aha Instant lasts until the final Elation Skill finishes this time.
When the Aha Instant ends, participating characters gain the "Certified Banger" state for the Punchline points taken into account this time, lasting for 2 turns. After Aha takes action, all Punchlines will be consumed.

extra.name: Extra Turn
extra.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

extra.name: RES PEN
extra.desc: When dealing DMG, ignore a part of the enemy target's resistance to the corresponding damage type.

skills.name: Behold Wherever Light Unfolds
skills.desc:
While Yao Guang holds "Certified Banger":
After an ally target uses an attack, triggers the "Great Boon" effect, dealing 1 additional instance of #1[f1]% Elation DMG of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, then additionally triggers "Great Boon" 1 time.
When triggering the "Great Boon" effect, if the attacker's Elation is lower than that of Yao Guang, then this instance of Elation DMG will take Yao Guang's Elation into calculation.
Triggering the "Great Boon" effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.
skills.simpleDesc: While Yao Guang holds "Certified Banger," after an ally target uses an attack, triggers "Great Boon": Deals 1 additional instance of minor Elation DMG of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, this effect triggers 1 extra time. This effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.

extra.name: Certified Banger
extra.desc:
Characters participating in the Aha Instant gain the "Certified Banger" state. And the Punchline points from the current Aha Instant are taken into account for this state, lasting for 2 turns. Ability effects and Elation DMG produced by the "Certified Banger" state are calculated based on the Punchline points taken into account.
Punchline points taken into account for multiple "Certified Banger" states are combined for the calculation.
The duration of each "Certified Banger" state is tracked independently.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

skills.name: Untethered Glimmer Sails Far
skills.desc: After using Technique, automatically triggers Skill 1 time at the start of the next battle without consuming any Skill Points. When Yao Guang is in the team, breaking destructible objects immediately grants Fortune Pouch, up to #1[i] within every Earth Week.
skills.simpleDesc: Upon entering combat, automatically triggers Skill 1 time. When Yao Guang is in the team, immediately gains Fortune Pouch when breaking destructible objects.

skills.name: Let Thy Fortune Burst in Flames
skills.desc: Inflicts "Woe's Whisper" on all enemies, lasting for #4[i] turn(s). Enemy targets under the "Woe's Whisper" state take #3[f1]% increased DMG. Deals #2[i]% Physical Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals #5[i] instance(s) of #6[i]% Physical Elation DMG to one random enemy.
skills.simpleDesc: Increases DMG received by all enemies. Deals Physical Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals minor Physical Elation DMG to one random enemy.

extra.name: Elation DMG
extra.desc:
The more Punchline taken into account, and the higher the Elation and Character Level, the greater the Elation DMG dealt.
Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

eidolons.name: Chuckle Chimes Where Jade Falls
eidolons.desc: In <u>Aha's</u> <u>extra turn</u> triggered by Ultimate, the fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> taken into account increases to <nobr>40</nobr>. When dealing <u>Elation DMG</u>, all ally targets ignore <nobr>20%</nobr> of the target's DEF.

eidolons.name: Blind Arrows Guided by Feathers
eidolons.desc: While the Zone is active, increases all ally targets' SPD by <nobr>12%</nobr>, and additionally increases Elation by <nobr>16%</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Auspices Mirrored In Decalight
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>10</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Threads of Fate Colored by Plumes
eidolons.desc: In <u>Aha's</u> <u>extra turn</u> triggered by Yao Guang's Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all ally characters' Elation Skill becomes <nobr>150%</nobr> of the original DMG.

Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <nobr>15</nobr>.

eidolons.name: Ferried Along the Astral Arc
eidolons.desc: All ally targets' <u>Elation DMG</u> <u>merrymakes</u> by <nobr>25%</nobr>. Increases the DMG multiplier of Yao Guang's Elation Skill by <nobr>100%</nobr> of its original multiplier.

Elation DMG is not affected by DMG Boost effects.

extra.desc: A special effect that affects Elation DMG and can additionally boost Elation DMG dealt.

embedBonusSkill.name: Amaze-In Grace
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Yao Guang's SPD is <nobr>120</nobr> or higher, increases this unit's Elation by <nobr>30%</nobr>. For every <nobr>1</nobr> SPD exceeded, increases this unit's Elation by <nobr>1%</nobr>. Up to a max of <nobr>200</nobr> excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

embedBonusSkill.name: Poised and Sated
embedBonusSkill.desc: Increases this unit's CRIT DMG by <nobr>60%</nobr>. After using Elation Skill, recovers <nobr>1</nobr> Skill Point(s) for the team.

embedBonusSkill.name: Felicity Ensemble
embedBonusSkill.desc: When Yao Guang gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>," its duration increases by <nobr>1</nobr> turn(s).
